name: victoria-sub
title: 260707-N-QV397-1018 HMCS Corner Brook (SSK 878) departs Pearl Harbor to begin RIMPAC 2026 sea phase.jpg
author: U.S. Navy photo by Mass Communication Specialist 3rd Class Mark Bergado
notes: Royal Canadian Navy Victoria-class submarine HMCS Corner Brook (SSK 878) on the surface, departing Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam for the RIMPAC 2026 sea phase, 7 July 2026 (DVIDS 9798323; Commons tag PD-USGov-Military-Navy). Clean side view, BOW LEFT: whole hull, sail with masts, whip antenna, Canadian flag and naval ensign, crew on the sail and deck, plus the upper rudder standing out of the water behind the stern. Original 5618x3745 (kept as assets-src/tmp-sea/sub/orig_victoria-sub.jpg) cropped to box 1050,150,5618,2350 and downscaled to 3200x1541 (PIL Lanczos, JPEG q95) = photos/victoria-sub.jpg. Canva remove-background + layer design exported as transparent lossless PNG 3200x1541 (pro); final = Canva alpha + photo RGB (scripts/alpha_cutout.py: 2 components = hull and rudder, rudder kept). Local alpha fixes (assets-src/tmp-sea/scripts/fix_sub.py, alpha only, photo RGB untouched): the whip antenna above the sail had a ~10 px band of sky around a ~3 px antenna -> alpha re-derived from darkness against the local sky inside Canva's band (box 1400,90,1520,382); the bow-wave foam wisp sticking out ahead of and under the nose erased with a polygon (x<330, y>1236). Verification fix (assets-src/tmp-verify3-sea/scripts/fix_sub_crew.py, alpha only, run on the final cut-out, then the same prep command): Canva had cut off the head (hair, sunglasses, face) and half of the water bottle of the crew member standing on deck against the right side of the sail, and left a half-transparent sliver between his back and the sail; three polygons traced on the photo (box 1766-1801 x 999-1078) restore them (pre-fix files kept in assets-src/tmp-verify3-sea/backup/). The bottom edge is the waterline with a little natural spray. The rudder is a separate piece in the cut-out; in the sticker its paper border joins the hull's at the waterline (small notch above). Sticker 1474x634. Checked at 800 px wide over the grid at 1x and 2x and against the photo: complete, no leftover water, no webbing (gaps between masts filled with paper), flags identical to the photo. Alternatives (PD US Navy): HMCS Victoria arriving at Bangor 2011 (US Navy 111212-N-GU530-103, 3/4 view) and Corner Brook RIMPAC 2026 260707-N-NR343-1124 (bow view, tug alongside).
